meaning:
κατα-καλύπτω
[in LXX chiefly for כָּסָה pi. ;]
to cover up; mid., to cover or veil oneself: 1Co.11:6; τ. κεφαλήν, 1Co.11:7.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
